name: Alan Turing
blurb: Defined what a computer even is, in 1936.

name: Ada Lovelace
blurb: Wrote the first algorithm, a century before the first computer.

name: Grace Hopper
blurb: Built the first compiler. Popularized the word "bug".

name: Frank Rosenblatt
blurb: Built the perceptron in 1958 -- that is week 1 of our workshop.

name: Claude Shannon
blurb: Invented information theory. Everything digital rests on it.

name: Marvin Minsky
blurb: Co-founded the MIT AI Lab. Wrote the book that paused neural nets.

name: Yann LeCun
blurb: Invented the convolutional neural network this very app runs on.

name: Yoshua Bengio
blurb: Shared the Turing Award for deep learning.

name: Fei-Fei Li
blurb: Built ImageNet -- the dataset our backbone was pretrained on.

name: Andrew Ng
blurb: Taught machine learning to millions of people online.

name: Timnit Gebru
blurb: Exposed how large AI models encode bias, and paid for it.

name: Joy Buolamwini
blurb: Proved face recognition fails on dark and female faces. Ask us about this one.

name: Judea Pearl
blurb: Gave AI a mathematics of cause and effect.

name: Katie Bouman
blurb: Wrote the imaging algorithm that photographed a black hole.

name: Cynthia Breazeal
blurb: Pioneered robots that read human social cues.
